transcript:
Tutor: What is an exogram?
Child: So this is an idea I've stored outside of your brain
Child: . Like you know, writing down a note on a piece of paper
Tutor: Mm-hmm. Yeah. You're pointing to something outside your head. Could a note or a sketch keep some information safe even if you weren't holding it in your mind right now?
Child: That's right. It's more durable
Child: . I'm able to
Child: ... store information outside of my brain or external to my mind
Child: . And a good example is something written down on a piece of paper
Tutor: Mm-hmm. Yeah, that fits. You've described it as memory kept in something like a note, rather than in your brain.
